description: **Headless: an explicit marker constant, and the guard thread's lock hold**: `proxy/src/headless.cpp` and `harness/watcher.ps1:855`: (a) the watcher finds `headless.marker` (`headless_status.json`) in `d3d9.dll` only because a log format string (`headless.cpp`, the `Log` line) contains it; rewording that log line would refuse every headless launch: add an explicit marker constant that a host test pins; (b) the guard thread holds `s_cs` while it enumerates monitors (every 25th poll, every poll while cloaked) and `HeadlessPresent` waits on the same lock: copy the monitor list out under the lock or enumerate outside it Why: (b) can add frame-time spikes; in the next job that changes `headless.cpp` anyway (B19, B22 and B23 are in the same file) Raised: napoleon J13 review Later 3 and 4, 2026-11-04
title: Headless: an explicit marker constant, and the guard thread's lock hold
